race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 2yo C&G Final (G1)
race.comment: SOME HIGH (10) was brave in his semi final last week, coming from a similar barrier to this to miss narrowly. That added to a string of wins and placings including an easy win in the heats. He has the talent to win this if things go his way from the second line. LAKE COMO (2) is progressing rapidly having overcome a back row draw to win by 2.8m last week. He is in peak form at the right time and the good draw should see this pan out nicely for him so expect him to go close. SOHO BELLAGIO (4) couldn't see it out after leading as favourite last week but he has shown good potential and is aided by a low draw so is worth another chance. AUSTON (1) has recorded a string of placing from tough barriers. The ace draw brings him into contention. A tough draw won't make this easy for SMACK BANG BART (11) but he is capable and deserving of respect.
